description: This file defines a custom Android UI component named AutoFitTextureView that extends TextureView. It allows setting a specific aspect ratio, and adjusts its measured dimensions accordingly to maintain this ratio.

classes.name: AutoFitTextureView
classes.description: A custom TextureView that maintains a specified aspect ratio, with methods to set the ratio and handle measurement to preserve this ratio.

methods.name: AutoFitTextureView
methods.description: Constructs the view with context, attribute set, and style.

methods.name: setAspectRatio
methods.description: Sets the desired aspect ratio for the view and requests layout update.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Overridden method to adjust the view's dimensions based on the aspect ratio.
